irrigationPolicy.title: Conditional irrigation
irrigationPolicy.saveFailed: The policy could not be saved. Check the affected fields and try again.
irrigationPolicy.conditionHelp: The gateway evaluates this condition at the selected schedule times.
irrigationPolicy.vwcDisabled: VWC conditions are turned off on this gateway. This policy does not irrigate until they are turned on.
irrigationPolicy.timingHelp: Conditions are evaluated at the selected schedule times. Without a selected schedule time, choose a fixed daily time.
irrigationPolicy.previewUnavailable: Legacy time preview unavailable until the gateway supplies its process timezone.
irrigationPolicy.runtimeHelp: Ready means the gateway acknowledged the clear-program update. It does not prove physical delivery.
irrigationPolicy.conversionHelp: The old 06:00 process-time run is shown in the policy timezone. Dendrometer hold or below-threshold days become skipped checks; they no longer water automatically.
irrigationPolicy.dendroBehavior: Dendrometer hold and below-threshold days are skips; response mode
irrigationPolicy.timezoneRequired: Enter a valid IANA timezone before saving.
irrigationPolicy.actionRefreshUnavailable: Action completed, but the current policy state could not be refreshed.

wet.label: Wet
wet.help: Water sooner to keep the soil wetter. Check at the scheduled time and water at 20 kPa or higher. This is a watering preference, not the current soil-status label.

moist.label: Moist
moist.help: Recommended. Allow some drying before watering. Check at the scheduled time and water at 30 kPa or higher.

dry.label: Dry
dry.help: Allow more drying before watering. Check at the scheduled time and water at 50 kPa or higher. This is a watering preference, not the current soil-status label.

irrigationPreference.invalidSchedule: SWT must be finite and between 0 and 300 kPa; duration must be a whole number from 1 to 240 minutes.
